title: Craft Product Thesis
problem: Product purpose, feature decisions, domain meaning, architecture, implementation, operation, and evidence are fragmented across tools and handoffs, so systems are built and changed without one owner-controlled continuity chain.
value_proposition: Craft helps an owner turn a Product Feature into a working, explainable system whose implementation traces to its meaning, whose observed behavior can be compared with expectations, and whose changes retain evidence, recovery obligations, and owner control.
value_mechanism: Embody CAV2-D20 Craft Method across context, shared meaning, Product Feature and Capability modeling, DomainSpec, exact realization selection, deterministic construction, independent conformance, and bounded runtime evidence; compare evidence with declared expectations to continue, repair, revise through the responsible owner, or stop; retain evidence, recovery and evolution obligations, residue, and successor state for explicit owners.
boundaries: Craft Product, Project, Method, Product Feature, Product Capability, public capability, and ledger state remain distinct identities
the CyberAlchemy Product Thesis is the parent context and the Craft Product Thesis is the immediate feature context
DomainSpec v2 and Craft are one Product lineage under former and current names
legacy DomainSpec-v2 paths remain source and implementation migration inputs until exact relocation evidence exists
construction, conformance, runtime evidence, and owner adoption remain separate claims
private Product and Method meaning cannot be published through Arcanum
this thesis authorizes no implementation, migration, publication, release, or deployment
hypotheses: stable continuity from Product Feature to runtime reduces construction and change burden
exact reusable realizations reduce architecture rediscovery without stealing owner meaning
deterministic construction plus independent observation detects consequential drift before release
typed successor states improve migration, recovery, rollback, and evolution
the modeling and evidence cost is lower than recurring integration and architecture drift
evidence_routes: exact preservation of selected working DomainSpec capabilities
one bounded target system constructed from an owner-selected Product Feature
migration, recovery, compensation, and rollback evidence
owner, builder, operator, and reviewer burden observations
counterevidence_routes: continuity modeling costs more than it saves
owners cannot distinguish source meaning from generated projections
exact realization selection blocks necessary adaptation without evidence benefit
construction and conformance repeat the same defects
runtime observations cannot remain bounded and attributable
a simpler Product and Method preserve the same guarantees
revision_criteria: a realization repeatedly violates a first-order principle
Craft fails to preserve Product-to-runtime continuity or owner control
deterministic construction cannot integrate with real target projects
system evolution cannot preserve compatibility, recovery, and residue
systemic counterevidence invalidates the value mechanism
a materially simpler Product and Method preserve the same guarantees
owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Craft Product owner

challenge_route: Challenge Craft Product identity and thesis through the Craft Product owner, rename continuity and legacy source meaning through the DomainSpec v2 and Craft Product owners, Project coordination through the Craft Project owner, and Method meaning through definitions-governance.
